posts.title: Pope Leo XIV: A Shepherd of Hope for Our Time
posts.excerpt: The Holy Father continues to inspire the Church with his message of peace and unity.
posts.excerpt_ti: ቅዱስ ኣቦ ብመልእኽቲ ሰላምን ሓድነትን ንቤተ ክርስቲያን ምትብባዕ ቀጺሉ ኣሎ።
posts.body:
The Holy Father continues to inspire the Church with his message of peace and unity.

This is an example post that shows how a news article looks. Edit or delete it on the Admin page (admin/).
posts.body_ti:
ቅዱስ ኣቦ ብመልእኽቲ ሰላምን ሓድነትን ንቤተ ክርስቲያን ምትብባዕ ቀጺሉ ኣሎ።

እዚ ዜና ከመይ ከም ዝመስል ዘርኢ ኣብነታዊ ጽሑፍ እዩ። ኣብ ገጽ ምምሕዳር (Admin) ቀይርዎ ወይ ደምስስዎ።

posts.title: The Beauty of Keren and Its People
posts.excerpt: A reflection on the faith, resilience and rich culture of our Eparchy in Eritrea.
posts.excerpt_ti: ብዛዕባ እምነት፡ ጽንዓትን ሃብታም ባህልን ኤጳርቅናና ኣብ ኤርትራ ዝገልጽ ሓሳብ።
posts.body:
A reflection on the faith, resilience and rich culture of our Eparchy in Eritrea.

This is an example post. Replace it with a real article.
posts.body_ti:
ብዛዕባ እምነት፡ ጽንዓትን ሃብታም ባህልን ኤጳርቅናና ኣብ ኤርትራ ዝገልጽ ሓሳብ።

እዚ ኣብነታዊ ጽሑፍ እዩ። ብሓቀኛ ጽሑፍ ቀይርዎ።

posts.title: Easter Celebrations in Our Parishes
posts.excerpt: Joyful liturgies and community celebrations across the Eparchy of Keren.
posts.excerpt_ti: ኣብ መላእ ኤጳርቅና ከረን ዝተኻየደ ሕጉስ ሊጡርጊያን ማሕበረሰባዊ በዓላትን።
posts.body:
Joyful liturgies and community celebrations across the Eparchy of Keren.

This is an example post. Add the photos of your celebration to its gallery.
posts.body_ti:
ኣብ መላእ ኤጳርቅና ከረን ዝተኻየደ ሕጉስ ሊጡርጊያን ማሕበረሰባዊ በዓላትን።

እዚ ኣብነታዊ ጽሑፍ እዩ። ስእልታት ጽምብልኩም ኣብ ጋለሪኡ ወስኹ።
